# IDF_DS source attribution

These three complete CSV members are unchanged extracts from **Fixed-Wing UAS
Telemetry Benchmark (IDF_DS)**, v1.0, by Cesar Garcia Gascon, with contributors
Javier Bas Bolufer, Pablo Castello Pedrero and Juan A. Garcia-Manrique.
Source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.16992976
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The exact official archive is Holybro Pixhawk.zip, MD5
8b990cc4c7ec1225a16e9a28225e5162. Member paths, sizes, CRC32 and SHA-256 are in
source_acquisition_manifest.json. They were re-acquired and verified on
2026-10-14. The complete 2.1 GB archive is not redistributed.

The accompanying manifests and derived monitoring outputs are project
adaptations; no dataset-author endorsement is implied. Two older locally retained
files ended in incomplete rows because their byte tails were absent. Those old
bytes and the v33 results are kept separately and are not called complete official
members. The corrected v34 replay uses the verified full files supplied here.
